text: Font size: The text is a bit small, especially the supporting copy and event details. Let’s scale it up so it’s easy to read on mobile. In-person: Let’s make it clearer that this is an in-person event. Location next to date/time: “Fresno” feels disconnected sitting next to the headline, away from the date and time. Let’s keep the location, date and time together in one spot. Audience: It should be clear right away that this is for real estate investors. Right now that’s buried in the body copy.
